Two other ways come to mind, and I offer them as ideas, not findings. Keep the working memory file somewhere only the adapter can reach, so the command line has to go through it. Or make the adapter the only thing that can decrypt memory at all, so a plain file never sits in a workspace an agent can write to. His README is candid that "Plaintext exists during staging and intentionally in restored workspaces", which is the trade that makes step 9 possible.
